LabDesignSystem.title: The Construction on Tracing Paper
LabDesignSystem.thesis: A geometric proof in progress — compass arcs, dimension lines, and construction marks on cream draughting paper. Every element is placed with the deliberateness of a technical drawing: no decoration that isn't also structural, no colour that isn't also information.
LabDesignSystem.colors_intro: One accent used by rule. All other colour is tonal variation of graphite on cream. No colour enters the system without a named rationale for what information it carries.
LabDesignSystem.type_intro: Three typefaces, each chosen for a specific information register. STIX Two Text carries the intellectual authority of mathematical typesetting. Spectral carries sustained readable argument. Departure Mono carries the precision of measurement without personality.

NamedRuleCard.one_red_statement: The compass-arc red appears exactly once per surface — on the single element that is active, current, or selected.
NamedRuleCard.no_decoration_statement: If removing an element makes the surface less informative, it was earning its place. If it makes it calmer, it was decoration.
NamedRuleCard.flat_by_construction_statement: No shadows. Depth from line weight and tonal ramp only — heavy lines are closer, ghost lines are background.

LabColors.page_intro: One accent used by rule. All other colour is tonal variation of graphite on cream. No colour enters the system without a named rationale for what information it carries.
LabColors.color_ground_usage: The ground. Every surface begins here. Warm, not clinical — the colour of cream draughting paper, not office-white. The word calques (French: tracing paper) is the name of the PhD software; this ground makes that etymology visible.
LabColors.color_ink_usage: Primary lines, headings, body text. The weight of a freshly-sharpened pencil. Not pure black — graphite on cream reads as precision, not harshness.
LabColors.color_ink_secondary_usage: Secondary annotations, labels, dates. The weight of a second-pass construction line — used for Departure Mono labels, supporting metadata, and dimension annotations.
LabColors.color_ink_ghost_usage: Tertiary grid lines, dividers, construction guides. The weight of a preliminary mark — present enough to structure the page, quiet enough not to compete with content.
LabColors.color_active_usage: The single active construction element per surface — current position, selected era, focused project. Never used for decoration. Its rarity is the point: when the eye finds it, it has found the foreground element.
LabColors.color_active_named_rule_body: The compass-arc red appears exactly once per surface. A second red means the first was wrong. Applied on this surface to the active breadcrumb segment — “Design System” — and nowhere else.

LabTypography.page_intro: Three typefaces, each chosen for a specific information register. STIX Two Text carries the intellectual authority of mathematical typesetting. Spectral carries sustained readable argument. Departure Mono carries the precision of measurement without personality.
LabTypography.specimen_title: 25 years of precise practice — two eras, one continuous proof.
LabTypography.specimen_body: AI in Education · Human-Computer Interaction · Peer-reviewed scholarship across seven institutions. Frontend engineering · Product UX · IoT & SaaS platforms at HubSpot, HiveMQ, Matillion. The portfolio spans two professional cultures — the rigour of peer review and the velocity of product shipping — and the visual language must hold both without favouring either.
LabTypography.rationale_display: STIX Two Text — the mathematical typesetting standard, designed for scientific journals and peer-reviewed papers. The italic cut carries a genuine geometric incline: not emphasis, but character.
LabTypography.rationale_headline: STIX Two Text italic at headline scale — used for section and project titles. The same incline as display, reduced to working size.
LabTypography.rationale_title: Spectral at medium weight — designed for screens, academic without stiffness. Holds position names and case study chapter titles without competing with the display face.
LabTypography.rationale_body: Spectral Regular — holds 65–72ch lines at 17px without fatigue. Pairs cleanly with STIX Two's scholarly register. The workhorse of the system.
LabTypography.rationale_label: Departure Mono — distinctive tabular-figures monospace with instrument-panel character. Used for dimension annotations, dates, tick marks, and tech tags. Less ubiquitous than JetBrains Mono.
LabTypography.incline_rule_body: The display face carries a geometric incline — not italics as emphasis, but incline as character. Italic variants of the body face are reserved for titles of works (papers, products) only.
LabTypography.incline_comparison_body_label: Body italic — titles of works only
